notes.title: Stick Mountain 1.4.0
notes.content:
Core Gameplay Adjustments:
Removed all attribute scaling on abilities.


Abilities now level exponentially:


Levels: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8 → 16 → 32 → 64 → 128 → 256 → 512


Skill point cost progression: 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 5


Passive skills now offer greater value across all skill trees.


Updated ability border sprites:


White – Normal Ability


Blue – Passive Ability


Green – Ultimate Ability



Ability Balancing:
General Changes:
Removed cooldown scaling when upgrading abilities.


Each character now has one passive that provides cooldown reduction.


All general scaling removed (damage, duration, etc.).


Movement abilities no longer scale excessively.


Skill Trees & Classes Updated:
Created dedicated Movement skill tree for all classes.


Removed Dash/Directional Dash from other trees.


Class Trees Adjusted:
Elementalist: Movement, Warchaser, Elementalist


Engineer: Movement, Savior, Engineer


Aquatic: Movement, Savior, Aquatic


Ranger: Movement, Guardian, Ranger


Pyro: Movement, Warchaser, Pyro Fury


Shadow: Movement, Guardian, Shadow



UI & Visual Updates:
Menus now feature a dark blue theme.


Updated UI elements:


Consistent button styling


Ability and equipment borders improved


Equipment hotbar color changed



Item & Equipment Changes:
General Adjustments:
Removed artifact drops: Titanium Gauntlet, Shield, Top Hats


Infected Uzi now uses correct sprite.


Shotgun: Projectile speed increased


Sidearms (Eagles & Revolvers): Now apply a slight movement speed decrease


Descriptions Updated:
Pellet Eagle now correctly notes Eagle Eye effect


Equipment Balancing:
Malware Disk: Increased default damage


Matrix Aura: Movement boost reduced from 25% → 8% at Level 1


Stat Distribution Changes:
Trinkets: Now give base Agility, Strength, or Intellect only


Artifacts:


Agility → Stamina Regen


Strength → Defense & Health Regen


Intellect → Mana Regen


Gear: Now provides base Agility, Strength/Defense, or Intellect


Scaling Adjustments:
Summon Campfire: Stamina & health regen now scale with level


Flame Shuriken: Fire damage now scales on upgrade



Progression & Economy Changes:
Shrine attribute rewards increased


Gems are rarer in late-game


Adjusted costs of trinkets, artifacts, and gear



Environment & Effects:
Added fog effects to:


Emberforge Crater


Nyxthra Jungle



Magic Weapon Balancing:
Upgrading magic weapons or throwables now increases mana/stamina cost

notes.title: Stick Mountain 1.0.3
notes.content:
Weapon Additions & Adjustments:

Snowball Cannon:

Redesigned.

New Weapons Added:

Proto Rifle
Infection Uzi
Radiation Uzi
Proto Uzi
Proto Handgun
Proto Shotgun
Titanium Bow
Titanium Crossbow
Titanium Handgun
Titanium Rifle
Titanium Eagle
Titanium Shotgun
Pellet Uzi
Pellet Shotgun
Pellet Revolver
Pellet Mountain Eagle
Pellet Sniper
Gilded Sniper
Titanium Sniper
Sniper
Gilded Revolver
Tungsten Revolver
Proto Revolver

Firework Launcher:

Moved to legendary quality.
Now has homing effect.

Snipers:

All now include laser sight.
Related Recipe Updates:
Proto Handgun added to S-Co Handgun recipe.
Proto Rifle added to S-Co Rifle recipe.

Weapon Movement Adjustments:

Increased movement speed for smaller weapons.

Throwable Items & Traps:

Aquatic Bomb:

Deals AOE damage.
Applies Soaked effect (reduces enemy attack speed by 50%).

Twig Trap:

Throwable trap that deals damage every 0.75 seconds.
Applies Trapped effect (slows enemy movement by 75%).

Malware Disk:

Pierces through 2 enemies.
Applies Hacked status effect (decreases enemy health regen by 75%).

Shadow Spike Trap:

Throwable trap that deals damage every 0.75 seconds.
Every 1 - 5 seconds, shoots a homing void projectile.
Applies Weak Void Chaos (greatly increases enemy knockback).

Magic Weapons:

Elemental Tome:

Fires mixed elemental projectiles (lightning bolt, fireball, icy shards).

Flame Shuriken:

Pierces 1 target.
Applies On Fire effect.

Character-Specific Loadouts:

Each character now has unique pellet-themed weapons:
Ranger: Pellet Shotgun, Pellet Revolver, Twig Trap
Aquatic: Pellet Sniper, Pellet Uzi, Water Bomb
Robot: Pellet Sniper, Pellet Mountain Eagle, Malware Disk
Elementalist: Pellet Rifle, Pellet Pistol, Elemental Tome
Flame: Pellet Shotgun, Pellet Uzi, Flame Shuriken
Shadow: Pellet Rifle, Pellet Revolver, Shadow Spike Trap

Ability Changes:

Dash:

Removed agility scaling of dash and directional dash.
Removed strength scaling.

New Ability - Elemental Summon (Elementalist Only):

Summons Flame, Frost, and Lightning Spirits.
Each spirit self-destructs and applies:
Deep Freeze (Frost)
On Fire (Flame)
Lightning Stun (Lightning)

notes.title: Stick Mountain 1.0.2
notes.content:
Gameplay Adjustments:

Exploration Waves:

* All exploration waves are now easy waves (3 mobs at once).

Shrine Adjustments:

* Attempted to fix spawning area of later level shrines.

Space Shrine:

* Sprite redesigned.

* Moved to a more open location.

Weapon & Item Changes:

New Weapons:

* Added Gilded Revolver.

* Added Tungsten Revolver.

Adjusted Sprites for:

* First Revolver

* Titanium Revolver

Scorch Seeker Mana Cost:

* Increased from 16 → 40.

Artifact Changes:

* Artifacts are now removed from drop tables (now obtained through crafting only).

* Adjusted all artifacts to give a base quality of 3.

Artifact Crafting Costs:

* Now starts at 1000 → Doubles per quality increase (1000 → 2000 → 4000 → etc.).

* All artifact rarities changed to rare.

* Recipes for artifacts added.

* Removed craftable weapons and artifacts from the marketplace.

Boss Material Drops:

* Boss materials now drop 1 - 3 at a 75% chance.

notes.title: Stick Mountain 1.0.1
notes.content:
Gameplay Adjustments:
Animal Hide Changes
* Crafting Costs: Reduced for all animal hide recipes.
* Drop Rate: Decreased.
Combat & Enemy Balancing
General Adjustments
* Grassy Mountain: Tweaked max health, attack power, attack delay, and movement speed.
* Snowy Peaks & Desert: Lowered health and decreased rare mob stats.
Status Effects
* Poison: Increased damage.
* Deep Freeze: Increased effect duration.
Projectile & Attack Changes
* Alien Laser Attack:
   * Increased attack spread from 15% → 45%.
   * Aliens now unlock the laser attack when below 50% health.
* Projectile Speed Adjustments:
   * Reduced projectile speed from 1000 → 700 - 800.
   * Overall decreased projectile speeds to improve dodging.
* Rare Mobs:
   * Adjusted stats for balance.
   * Tanky Enemies: Increased defense (countered by magic weapons).
   * Magic-Type Enemies: Now have natural shield regeneration (countered by physical weapons).
________________


Weapon & Ability Changes:
Weapon Adjustments:
Pierce Counts:
* Crossbows: Descriptions updated to include pierce count.
* Throwables: Now have a pierce count of 2.
Damage Adjustments:
* Pellet Rifle & Pellet Pistol:
   * Increased damage.
   * Now have a reload time.
* Magic Weapons: Now deal slightly more damage than default weapons.
Weapon Reworks
* Shotgun: Projectiles now have a cutoff range (no more "shotgun sniping").
* Crossbow: Now heavy-hitting with 1 pierce.
Reload Speed Adjustments:
* Rifles: Reload time slightly increased (2 - 6 sec).
* Pistols: Reload time slightly decreased (1 - 3 sec).
* Weapon recoil removed.
Ability Adjustments:
* Dash Ability:
   * Now available in all character-specific skill trees (was Warchaser-exclusive).
   * Buffed dash impulse for better movement.
* Rejuvenation Ability:
   * Healing curve now starts at 40% HP and increases faster at lower health.
* Flying Equipment:
   * Flying now only activates when already in the air (allows jumping/dodging while grounded).
________________


Enemy & Wave Spawning Adjustments:
Shrines & Mobs:
* Increased mob spawn amount for shrines.
* Adjusted spawned mobs in shrines.
Wave System Changes:
Wave Spawn Adjustments:
* Starting Wave: 5 max mobs at once.
* Each wave after: +5 max mobs.
* Increased mob spawns for all levels.
* Increased min/max mobs per wave.
* Added more post-wave mob spawns for all levels.
New Spawners
* Proximity Spawners: Added more spawners between quest destinations and objectives.
* Random Spawners: 25% chance to activate in specific areas on all levels.
* Exploration Spawners: Added more enemy spawners while exploring.
________________


Player Stats & Progression:
Player Movement:
* Increased default player speed from 800 → 1000.
Stat Adjustments:
* Health Regen from Strength: 0.02 → 0.14 (significantly increased).
* Max Health from Strength: 7 → 4 (lowered).
* Stamina Regen from Agility: 0.1 → 0.2 (higher).
* Mana Regen from Intellect: 0.05 → 0.12 (higher).
XP & Progression:
* Base XP Gain: 20 → 40.
* Additive XP Factor: 10 → 30.
* Updated Skill Descriptions: Adjusted descriptions for Oceanic Rescuer, Pool of Hydration, and Wave Rider.
________________


Miscellaneous Changes:
* Solaran Son Quest: Removed extra dialogue.
* Environmental Additions: Added cardboard box decorations to Hub & Cabins.
* Money Drop Adjustments: Increased money drops from crates and pots.
________________


Bug Fixes & Additional Balancing:
Autosave Fix:
* Resolved issue where autosave file names kept increasing in length.
Mob Scaling Adjustments:
* Enemy health scaling adjusted to increase ~2x per level.
* Adjusted weapon damage scaling to ensure crafted weapons remain effective.
Threat Range Adjustment:
* Enemies now track players more effectively.
Flying Enemies:
* Fixed flying speed inconsistencies.
Enemy Balance Adjustments:
* Increased enemy attack damage slightly.
* Increased enemy movement speed.
* Boss Buffs:
   * Luminfang buffed.
   * Shadow Creature buffed.
* Adjusted knockback taken by tankier enemies.
Additional Adjustments:
* Reduced emissive strength of volcano-related sprites.
* Increased stamina cost of throwables.
* Sniper now has a pierce of 3.
* Magicicle: 50% chance to apply Deep Freeze to enemies.
* Snowball Cannon: 50% chance to apply Freeze to enemies.
* Flame Staff: Increased projectile amount from 1 → 3.
* Lightning Tome: Now fires homing lightning bolts.
________________


Boss Reworks:
Luminfang Changes:
* Projectiles now go through walls.
* Main attack has a higher spray range.
* Flies quicker.
Shadow Creature Adjustments:
* Void projectiles slightly home in if too close.
* Moves a lot quicker.
Zandalath Changes:
* Shoots homing lasers by default.
* Moves slightly faster.
* Longer cooldown on Blood Fury attack.
